idea-plugin.name: Material Companion
idea-plugin.description:
A Material Design-inspired dark editor color scheme -- cool greys, blues, teals, and purples -- with zero forced UI elements, zero paywalled customization, and zero performance cost.

Built from real JetBrains Marketplace reviews of the leading Material-style theme plugin (18.6M downloads, 80% of recent reviews at 3 stars or fewer despite active development): an intrusive floating action button added by a recent update that free users cannot disable without paying ("Forcing this intrusive UI element on users is a terrible design choice"), repeated performance complaints ("my Idea even becomes unresponsive at times"), and basic customization locked behind a subscription.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no floating buttons, no forced UI you have to pay to turn off. Turn it on the same way as any built-in theme: Settings > Appearance & Behavior > Appearance.
